entries.label: Abnormal volume
entries.summary: Relative volume of at least 2.5x its 10-day average, ranked by relative volume.

entries.label: High volatility
entries.summary: ATR(14) as a percent of price at least 4%, ranked by volatility.

entries.label: Gap up
entries.summary: Gaps up 3% or more on at least 1.5x relative volume at the 08:30 ET premarket scan.

entries.label: Gap down
entries.summary: Gaps down 3% or more at the 08:30 ET premarket scan, biggest gap first.

entries.label: New 20-day high
entries.summary: Close crosses above the 20-day high, ranked by relative volume.

entries.label: 52-week breakout
entries.summary: Close crosses above the 52-week high (252 trading days), ranked by relative volume.

entries.label: Oversold RSI
entries.summary: Daily RSI(14) below 30, most oversold first.

entries.label: Overbought RSI
entries.summary: Daily RSI(14) above 70, most overbought first.

entries.label: Above VWAP on volume
entries.summary: Price above VWAP on at least 2x relative volume, checked every 5-minute bar.

entries.label: Top movers
entries.summary: Up 4% or more against the prior close, checked every 15-minute bar.

entries.label: Hammer
entries.summary: Alerts when a hammer prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Inverted hammer
entries.summary: Alerts when an inverted hammer prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Bullish engulfing
entries.summary: Alerts when a bullish engulfing prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Piercing line
entries.summary: Alerts when a piercing line prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Morning star
entries.summary: Alerts when a morning star prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Dragonfly doji
entries.summary: Alerts when a dragonfly doji prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Tweezer bottom
entries.summary: Alerts when a tweezer bottom prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Bullish harami
entries.summary: Alerts when a bullish harami prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Three white soldiers
entries.summary: Alerts when three white soldiers print on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar downtrend.

entries.label: Shooting star
entries.summary: Alerts when a shooting star prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Hanging man
entries.summary: Alerts when a hanging man prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Bearish engulfing
entries.summary: Alerts when a bearish engulfing prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Dark cloud cover
entries.summary: Alerts when a dark cloud cover prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Evening star
entries.summary: Alerts when an evening star prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Gravestone doji
entries.summary: Alerts when a gravestone doji prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Tweezer top
entries.summary: Alerts when a tweezer top prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Bearish harami
entries.summary: Alerts when a bearish harami prints on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Three black crows
entries.summary: Alerts when three black crows print on a 15-minute bar after a 5-bar uptrend.

entries.label: Doji
entries.summary: Alerts when a doji prints on a 15-minute bar.

entries.label: Inside bar
entries.summary: Alerts when an inside bar prints on a 15-minute bar.

entries.label: Opening range breakout (15m)
entries.summary: Closes above the 15-minute opening range high on at least 2x relative volume and above VWAP.

entries.label: Pre-market high break
entries.summary: Closes above the pre-market high on at least 1.5x relative volume between 09:30 and 11:00 ET.

entries.label: Gap and go
entries.summary: Gaps 3% or more up or down at the 08:30 ET premarket scan on at least 2x relative volume.

entries.label: N-day breakout
entries.summary: Daily close crosses above the 20-day high on at least 1.5x relative volume.

entries.label: High-of-day break
entries.summary: Closes above the session high on at least 1.5x relative volume between 09:45 and 15:30 ET.

entries.label: VWAP reclaim
entries.summary: Closes back above VWAP between 09:45 and 15:30 ET, checked every 1-minute bar.

entries.label: VWAP loss
entries.summary: Closes below VWAP between 09:45 and 15:30 ET, checked every 1-minute bar.

entries.label: Pullback to 20/50
entries.summary: Daily close within 1% of the 20- or 50-day average while the 20-day sits above the 50-day.

entries.label: RSI reversal
entries.summary: Daily RSI(14) crosses back above 30, leaving oversold territory.

entries.label: Technical bias change
entries.summary: Technical summary bias crosses above +0.1 or below -0.1, checked every 15-minute bar.

entries.label: Red to green
entries.summary: Closes above the prior day's close on at least 1.5x relative volume, checked every 5-minute bar.

entries.label: EMA 9/21 cross
entries.summary: The 9-period EMA crosses the 21-period EMA in either direction, checked every 15-minute bar.

entries.label: Golden / death cross 50/200
entries.summary: The 50-day SMA crosses the 200-day SMA in either direction, checked daily.

entries.label: MACD signal cross
entries.summary: The MACD line (12, 26, 9) crosses its signal line in either direction, checked daily.

entries.label: Volume spike
entries.summary: Relative volume of at least 3x its 10-day average between 09:45 and 15:45 ET, checked every 1-minute bar.

entries.label: Abnormal volume on an up day
entries.summary: Daily relative volume of at least 2x its 10-day average on a close above the prior close.

entries.label: Futures overnight-range break
entries.summary: Closes through the overnight high or low on /ES or /NQ, checked every 1-minute bar.
